rawContent: Ferguson happened under a Black president who worked very hard to diffuse/calm protests. #GeorgeFloyd is happening under the literal Anti-#BlackLivesMatter president, openly racist ruling party & a Dem Party impotent in speaking to community pain. This can go further than before
@AndrewMaycock6 No man your job here if you care about #BlackLivesMatter is to respect Black leadership, not telling them how to struggle

Early Sunday @AbbyMartin gave birth to our child. She went into labor marching 9mos pregnant all day with #BlackLivesMatter in Beverly Hills. Her commitment to solidarity—plus incredible strength—delivered us this little human. Abby has been amazing, her and baby healthy & happy!

Just drove to the store & the whole drive people everywhere just on street corners by themselves holding #BlackLivesMatter signs. Outside constant mass actions people not yet in the movement are inspired to take individual actions like this. Incredible, never see anything like it
